law: A candidate family is not a skeleton. Canon templates stay 22 until a file clears digest+INDEX+rehearsal.

decisions.name: LOOKUP / ENRICH
decisions.rationale: No CRM skeleton exists. Do not add hubspot-lookup. Provider-neutral lookup-and-enrich.nika.yaml lives under eval/hot/proposed-skeletons until digest/INDEX/rehearsal gates. Unlocks B03/C02/C03/F10.

decisions.name: FACTS → DRAFT
decisions.rationale: chain generates but does not preserve source facts as a first-class output. facts-to-draft teaches {facts, generated}.

decisions.name: RECONCILE → PROPOSAL
decisions.rationale: snapshot-diff is compare-only (bounded 8 strings). Proposed mutations are a layer on DIFF, not a new vendor template. Keep apply split (P04). No reconcile-and-propose in canon yet.

decisions.name: APPROVE → APPLY
decisions.rationale: human-gated-ship already: parallel gates → blocking nika:prompt → act → always-record. Do not add approve-and-apply.nika.yaml.

decisions.name: KNOWN DAG + AGENT FALLBACK
decisions.rationale: agent-loop is whole-workflow EXPLORE. Need known-path-agent-fallback as composition teaching file. Not HOT-forced.

decisions.name: LOOKUP → DECIDE → GATE/EFFECT
decisions.rationale: Would become a giant domain template. Compose P01 + classify-and-route + P04. Support-triage G05 is the golden.

decisions.name: JOIN / ENRICH TWO SOURCES
decisions.rationale: Deterministic jq join; no new complete skeleton until a unique law vs snapshot-diff/aggregate is proven in tests.

decisions.name: chain as HOT family
decisions.rationale: TOO_GENERIC. Near-miss magnet for any read→LLM→write.
